name: CPU Backend
description: CPUBackend, the CPU RenderBackend and pixel reference (Sources/CoreRender/CPU), supporting every op family: its surfaces are PixelBuffers held in the shared SurfaceStore; surface, read and release go through the SurfaceStore; display and composite (every blend mode, gated by its family) are the CoreRaster calls themselves, composite blending the stored backdrop in place under the store's lock so composites onto one surface apply one at a time, and crop, rotate, resample, blur, unsharp, each tone adjustment and masked clone (CPUBackend+Ops) each call the CoreRaster method they name and return a new surface. CoreRaster errors map to RenderError.raster with the same message. Each W1 family answers from its own file, CPUBackend+MaskedComposite, +Affine, +Effect and +Color (the color tone cases, reached from adjusted's switch): a stub that checks its surfaces under the family's gate and throws RenderError.unsupported(<family>) until its feature fills that file.
